# Callouts: Recovery 5B - factory restore: SOP0 and SOP1 straps (only after the backup)

Source: Own photos, raptox's unit: stitched microscope mosaic of 2026-11-03 (~229 px/mm)  
Annotated image: [images/annotated/rec5-b_factory-straps.jpg](../../../images/annotated/rec5-b_factory-straps.jpg)

Two straps from U15 pin 8, each through 470 Ω, onto X4 (SOP0) and X5 (SOP1). X6 (SOP2) stays free. Never before two equal backups exist.
